**Work Mode:** Hybrid

Job Summary

We are looking for a results-driven US IT Recruiter with 2–4 years of experience in US staffing and recruitment. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in sourcing, screening, and submitting qualified IT candidates for contract, C2C, W2, and full-time positions. The candidate must be familiar with US job portals, Boolean search techniques, recruitment processes, and US work authorization requirements.

Key Responsibilities

* Source qualified IT candidates through job portals such as Dice, Monster, CareerBuilder, LinkedIn, and other recruitment platforms.
* Review job descriptions (JDs), understand client requirements, and identify suitable candidates for open positions.
* Perform Boolean searches, keyword searches, and resume screening to identify candidates matching technical requirements.
* Conduct initial candidate screenings to evaluate technical skills, experience, communication, availability, location, and work authorization.
* Recruit for various IT positions, including Software Developers, Java Developers, .NET Developers, QA Engineers, Business Analysts, DevOps Engineers, Cloud Engineers, Data Engineers, and other technical roles.
* Work on contract, C2C, W2, 1099, and full-time hiring requirements, as applicable.
* Coordinate with candidates to obtain updated resumes, confirm pay rates, discuss job details, and schedule interviews.
* Submit qualified candidates to clients, implementation partners, and vendors within the required turnaround time.
* Maintain regular communication with candidates and follow up on submissions, interviews, feedback, offers, and joining dates.
* Build and maintain a strong candidate pipeline and database for current and future requirements.
* Verify candidate availability, employment details, location, work authorization, and willingness to relocate or work onsite when required.
* Coordinate with Account Managers, Business Development Managers, and other recruiters to meet recruitment targets.
* Maintain accurate candidate information, submission records, and recruitment activity in the ATS or internal tracking system.
* Ensure candidate quality, timely submissions, and compliance with client-specific recruitment procedures.

Required Skills and Qualifications

* 2–4 years of hands-on experience in US IT recruitment.
* Strong knowledge of the US IT staffing industry and recruitment lifecycle.
* Experience working with Dice, Monster, LinkedIn Recruiter, CareerBuilder, or similar sourcing platforms.
* Proficiency in Boolean search, resume sourcing, candidate screening, and talent pipeline management.
* Understanding of C2C, W2, 1099, contract, and full-time hiring models.
* Familiarity with US work authorization categories and the ability to verify candidate-provided information appropriately.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, follow-up, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to understand technical job descriptions and match candidates based on skills and experience.
* Ability to work independently in a target-driven environment and manage multiple requirements simultaneously.
* Good organizational skills and attention to detail.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience recruiting for C2C requirements and working with implementation partners and staffing vendors.
* Experience with urgent requirements and time-sensitive candidate submissions.
* Familiarity with ATS tools, recruitment trackers, and candidate relationship management.
* A consistent track record of meeting submission, interview, and placement targets.

Performance Expectations

* Timely and relevant candidate submissions.
* Strong candidate-to-job-description matching.
* Consistent sourcing and screening productivity.
* Effective candidate follow-up and interview coordination.
* Achievement of monthly recruitment targets.
* High-quality candidate documentation and database maintenance.

What We Offer

* Competitive salary based on experience and performance.
* Performance-based incentives.
* Opportunities to work on diverse US IT staffing requirements.
* Professional development and career growth opportunities.
* A collaborative and target-oriented work environment.

**Interested candidates can share their updated resume along with their current CTC, expected CTC, notice period, and relevant US IT recruitment experience.**

**ABOUT THE HUB**

Bureau Veritas is building a greenfield HR Shared Services hub in Noida. The hub will bring HR operations that currently run separately in each country into one standardised, digitally enabled service centre. You will design your tower, move work into Noida in structured waves, and run it at scale to global standards.

**ROLE PURPOSE**

You own the recruitment and onboarding engine for every country moving into Noida. You will replace fragmented local practices with one standard, compliant and fast hiring process. Hiring managers should get the talent they need quickly, and every candidate should get a consistent, high-quality experience.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Transition and shared services set-up**

* Map current recruitment and onboarding practice in each country, including steps, tools, vendors, volumes and cycle times, and set the baseline.
* Design the R2H target operating model. Define what moves to the hub, what stays with in-country recruiters and business partners, and what goes to vendors or RPO partners.
* Lead country-by-country transition, covering knowledge transfer, template and offer-letter harmonisation, and stabilisation after cutover.
* Set up the hub's scheduling, offer and onboarding desks, with capacity models tied to hiring forecasts.

**2. Process ownership and service delivery**

* Act as Global Process Owner for R2H. Own the standard process from requisition to day one, including approval rules and local variations.
* Manage recruitment and background-check vendors across markets. Scorecard them on time-to-fill, quality of hire, diversity and cost.
* Map the candidate journey from end to end, remove friction points, and lift offer acceptance and employer-brand scores.
* Deliver a consistent onboarding experience. New joiners should have their systems, equipment and paperwork ready on day one.
* Act as the escalation point for hiring managers and TA partners on service issues.

**3. Governance, risk and controls**

* Work with Legal, Compliance and country HR to keep every step compliant with local labour law, right-to-work rules and data privacy law.
* Own controls over offer approvals, compensation within band, and the retention and deletion of candidate data.
* Embed BV's DEI standards in sourcing, shortlisting and vendor contracts, and report on them regularly.

**4. Continuous improvement and digital**

* Drive full ATS adoption and automate scheduling, offer generation and e-signature.
* Introduce AI-enabled tools for screening and scheduling, with fairness and privacy safeguards.
* Use funnel analytics to find where time is lost, and fix causes at their source.

**5. People leadership, performance and culture**

* Build the tower's team from the ground up. Define the structure, spans of control, role profiles and hiring plan for each transition wave.
* Recruit, onboard and develop team leads and specialists. Build succession cover for every critical role before the tower reaches steady state.
* Run a disciplined people-performance cycle covering goal setting, monthly one-to-ones, quarterly reviews and calibrated year-end ratings.
* Keep attrition, absence and engagement at or better than hub targets. Act early on hotspots.
* Model the hub culture of ownership, customer focus, speed with control and learning. Make it visible in how the team works every day.
* Build capability through skills matrices, cross-training and certification paths. Create career moves across towers.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* First 90 days: TA baseline, R2H operating model and vendor strategy agreed.
* By go-live: scheduling, offer and onboarding desks live for the first wave of countries.

description:
HR Department Noida Full Time
**Key Responsibilities**

  

  

1\. Talent Acquisition Strategy \& End\-to\-End Hiring


* Own the end\-to\-end recruitment lifecycle from manpower requirement and role calibration through sourcing, assessment, offer management, pre\-boarding, and joining.


* Translate business and workforce requirements into effective talent acquisition strategies and hiring plans.


* Drive multiple hiring mandates simultaneously across technology and business functions while maintaining strong focus on quality, speed, and candidate experience.


* Own hiring for critical and niche positions across Software Engineering, Cloud, DevOps, Kubernetes, SRE, AI/ML, Data, Cybersecurity, Product, Project Management, Solution Engineering, Sales, Business Development, and other emerging technology domains.


* Build recruitment plans aligned with business priorities, headcount plans, hiring budgets, role criticality, and expected timelines.


* Ensure a strong balance between speed of closure, quality of talent, compensation alignment, and long\-term fit.

  

  

2\. Stakeholder Partnership \& Hiring Advisory


* Partner with Hiring Managers, Department Heads, and senior stakeholders to understand business priorities, team structures, role expectations, competencies, and hiring timelines.


* Act as a trusted talent advisor to business leaders by providing insights on talent availability, market trends, compensation benchmarks, competitor hiring, and sourcing feasibility.


* Conduct detailed role intake and requirement calibration to establish clear hiring criteria and candidate evaluation parameters.


* Challenge and refine hiring requirements where required to improve talent accessibility and quality.


* Establish strong stakeholder governance through regular hiring reviews, pipeline discussions, hiring dashboards, and closure plans.


* Proactively identify hiring risks and recommend alternate strategies to ensure critical positions are closed within agreed timelines.

  

  

3\. Talent Sourcing \& Pipeline Development


* Build and maintain high\-quality, proactive talent pipelines for critical, niche, recurring, and future hiring requirements.


* Develop multi\-channel sourcing strategies across LinkedIn, Naukri, Instahyre, referrals, professional communities, technology forums, job boards, networking, and direct sourcing.


* Drive passive candidate engagement and build long\-term relationships with high\-potential talent.


* Develop talent pools for specialised technology areas where traditional sourcing channels may have limited effectiveness.


* Build and maintain a strong talent CRM mindset, ensuring promising candidates remain engaged for future opportunities.


* Develop targeted sourcing strategies based on role complexity, geography, seniority, skill availability, and market conditions.


4\. Talent Intelligence \& Market Mapping


* Conduct talent mapping, market intelligence, competitor mapping, and talent availability analysis for difficult\-to\-hire and strategic roles.


* Research and identify relevant talent clusters, companies, technology communities, and emerging talent markets.


* Build talent intelligence that supports workforce planning and future hiring requirements.


* Provide leadership with actionable insights on talent supply, demand, compensation trends, notice periods, competitor hiring activity, and market availability.


* Develop targeted talent maps for specialised areas such as Cloud, Kubernetes, AI/ML, GPU infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, Cybersecurity, and emerging technology roles.

  

  

5\. Candidate Assessment \& Interview Management


* Conduct structured initial screening, competency\-based discussions, and talent assessments to evaluate technical relevance, career trajectory, motivation, communication, and organisational fit.


* Partner with technical and functional interview panels to ensure consistent, structured, and efficient candidate evaluation.


* Coordinate interview processes, panel availability, candidate movement, feedback collection, and decision\-making.


* Establish strong recruitment discipline around timely feedback and funnel movement.


* Ensure candidates receive a professional, transparent, and engaging experience throughout the recruitment journey.


6\. Offer Management, Negotiation \& Closure


* Own the complete offer\-to\-join journey, including compensation discussions, offer negotiation, counter\-offer management, pre\-joining engagement, and joining follow\-up.


* Partner with HR and business stakeholders to ensure compensation proposals are aligned with internal parity, market benchmarks, role criticality, and hiring budgets.


* Develop effective strategies to manage counteroffers, competing offers, notice\-period challenges, and candidate drop\-offs.


* Maintain consistent engagement with selected candidates between offer acceptance and joining to maximise the Offer\-to\-Join Ratio.


* Build strong candidate relationships that extend beyond offer acceptance and contribute to long\-term talent engagement.

  

  

7\. Employer Branding \& Talent Engagement


* Partner with HR and Marketing/Brand teams to strengthen Coredge’s employer value proposition and talent brand.


* Support recruitment campaigns, hiring events, employee referral programs, talent communities, university/industry initiatives, and candidate engagement programs.


* Identify opportunities to position Coredge as an attractive destination for technology and cloud talent.


* Create compelling recruitment communication and candidate touchpoints aligned with Coredge’s technology story, culture, and growth journey.


* Contribute to building a strong external talent presence across relevant professional and technology communities.

  

  

8\. Recruitment Analytics \& Data\-Driven Hiring


* Own and monitor key recruitment metrics including:


 Time to Fill


 Time to Hire


 Quality of Hire


 Offer\-to\-Join Ratio


 Source Effectiveness


 Funnel Conversion


 Candidate Drop\-off


 Hiring Manager Satisfaction


* Develop and maintain recruitment dashboards and reports for leadership visibility.


* Analyse hiring data to identify pipeline gaps, process bottlenecks, sourcing inefficiencies, and conversion challenges.


* Use data and market intelligence to continuously optimise recruitment strategy and resource allocation.


* Ensure accurate and timely recruitment data across the ATS/HRMS.

  

  

9\. AI, Automation \& Recruitment Technology


* Leverage AI\-enabled recruitment tools, automation, talent intelligence platforms, and recruitment analytics to improve sourcing efficiency and hiring outcomes.


* Explore and implement technology\-led approaches for candidate discovery, talent mapping, profile screening, candidate engagement, interview coordination, and recruitment reporting.


* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive recruitment processes while maintaining human judgement and candidate quality.


* Stay updated with emerging AI and Talent Acquisition technologies and evaluate their relevance to Coredge’s recruitment ecosystem.


* Promote a technology\-first and continuously improving approach to Talent Acquisition.

  

  

10\. Recruitment Process Excellence


* Identify gaps and inefficiencies across the recruitment funnel and implement scalable, standardised, and outcome\-driven hiring processes.


* Continuously improve sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offer management, and pre\-boarding workflows.


* Establish recruitment SLAs and ensure adherence to agreed timelines.


* Develop and maintain recruitment SOPs, templates, dashboards, and process documentation.


* Build a consistent recruitment experience across functions while adapting strategies to the specific requirements of different business units.


* Champion continuous improvement, operational excellence, and process discipline within Talent Acquisition

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.


* 3–7 years of relevant experience in Talent Acquisition, Recruitment, or Technical Recruitment.


* Proven experience in end\-to\-end technology hiring, preferably within IT, SaaS, Cloud, Product, AI, or other technology\-driven organisations.
